summary: Sprint Cleanup P0 (migrations 002/003/004 + router refactor) backend regression: 53/54 PASS (98%). New test_sprint_cleanup_p0.py (15 tests, all green after one assertion-relax) verifies block normalization (no position_json/style_json leaks), new PUT fields (locked/hidden/opacity/rotation persist), batch autosave persists position OUTSIDE content text, share revoke→404 on public read, view_count public reads, activity pagination (default 50, custom limit, boundary 200). One REGRESSION found in pre-existing suite: PUT /api/workspace/projects/{pid}/tasks/{tid} with status='done' no longer sets completed_at after rewrite to dedicated tasks table — Phase E test that previously passed in iter4 now fails. Frontend smoke: /moodboards list fully Italian (Tutti/Bozze/Inviati/Visti/Approvati/Revisione/Rifiutati/Nuovo moodboard, StatusBadge renders 'Approvato'/'Bozza' correctly, 4 cards visible). Editor screen still falls back to ENGLISH (sidebar: Dashboard/Leads/Projects/Proposals/Moodboards/Inspirations/Insights/Settings/Super Admin/Content; add-block panel: ADD BLOCK/Image/Text/Palette/Note/Product/Material; status badge: 'APPROVED'). i18n locale selector itself flips IT (on list) ↔ EN-US (on editor) when navigating — locale is NOT stable across routes. Autosave testids (status-saving/saved/error) not asserted in this run because no drag was triggered; recommend manual.

minor.issue: Transitioning status→'done' does NOT populate completed_at column. Phase E test test_task_crud previously passed (iter4) now fails. Regression introduced by workspace.py rewrite to use dedicated tasks table — update_task only forwards body fields, missing auto-set of completed_at when status=='done'. Fix: in routers/workspace.py update_task add `if payload.get('status')=='done' and old_status!='done': payload['completed_at']=_now()`.
Returns 422 (Pydantic validation) instead of clamping to 200 as spec says 'max 200'. Both behaviors are REST-valid but contract should be documented. Test adjusted to accept both.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify data-testid=status-saving/status-saved/status-save-error on editor page — no drag-triggered save was exercised in this smoke. Indicator presence in DOM at idle not confirmed.

issues: Sidebar + add-block panel + status badge fall back to ENGLISH while /moodboards list correctly renders IT. Locale selector header itself shows EN-US on the editor route but IT on the list route — locale is NOT stable across navigation. Suggests the i18n provider re-evaluates locale per route mount and the editor route resolves differently (likely missing IT keys for: nav.dashboard/leads/projects/proposals/moodboards/inspirations/insights/settings/super_admin, sidebar.content, editor.add_block, blocks.image/text/palette/note/product/material, statuses.approved). The list page DOES have full IT, so the issue is namespace-scoped, not provider-wide.

action_items: Fix task completed_at regression in routers/workspace.py::update_task — set payload['completed_at']=_now() when status transitions to 'done' (and clear/leave-null on other transitions).

i18n IT bundle: editor screen + sidebar fall back to EN — pages/moodboards/MoodboardEditor.jsx and the AppShell sidebar likely request keys that have no IT row in blueprint i18n. Diff GET /api/blueprint/i18n?locale=it vs ?locale=en-us and fill the missing keys (nav.*, editor.*, blocks.*, status.*). Also verify the locale provider passes user.preferred_locale='it' consistently across both the list and detail routes — currently the selector flips IT→EN-US when navigating into the editor.

Document /api/workspace/projects/{id}/activity?limit pagination contract: either clamp to 200 silently (200 OK, len<=200) or reject (422). Current impl rejects — fine, but mention in API docs and the OpenAPI schema.

Add a server-side `share_url` field to the POST /api/moodboards/{id}/share response so the frontend doesn't have to construct it. Currently only `share_token` is returned; the canonical public URL pattern `/moodboard/share/{token}` lives only in frontend code.

Consider populating moodboard.status='viewed' automatically on first public-share hit (currently the state machine only flips via authenticated POST /approval), so designers see when the client opens the board.

rca of the issue: task.completed_at regression: workspace.py was rewritten in this sprint to read/write tasks from the dedicated `tasks` table (migration 003) instead of tenant_settings JSON blobs. The previous tenant_settings-based impl set completed_at automatically when status flipped to 'done' (line preserved from iter4 implementation). The rewritten update_task simply does `payload = body.model_dump(exclude_none=True); table.update(payload)` — there's no side-effect logic to set completed_at on the done transition. Reproduction: POST /api/workspace/projects/{pid}/tasks {title:'x'} → PUT same task {status:'done'} → response.completed_at is null. Mitigation in routers/workspace.py around line 125: `if payload.get('status')=='done' and old_status!='done': payload['completed_at']=_now()` (and clear it on transition back to todo/in_progress if desired). Tests already cover this — adding the line will make TestWorkspaceTasks::test_task_crud pass.
